principles: Density with Breathing Room: Use dense tables for data, but spacious padding for containers.
No Gradients on Text: Keep text solid and high-contrast.
Subtle Borders > Heavy Shadows: Use 1px borders to define structure, shadows should be ambient only.
Interactive Feedback: Every clickable element must have a hover and active state.
Data-First: Charts and numbers should be the heroes, not the illustrations.
anti_patterns: Do not use 'Inter' for everything. Use tighter tracking for headings to make them distinct.
Avoid full-screen gradients. Use white/gray backgrounds for a professional tool feel.
Don't center-align dashboard widgets. Left-align for scanability.
Never use generic 'Lorem Ipsum'. Use realistic sales data (e.g., 'Acme Corp', '$12,500', 'Negotiation').

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the dashboard using the 'Bento' grid layout. Use the provided color palette variables in Tailwind. Ensure the sidebar is collapsible or distinct from the main content area. Use 'Recharts' for all data visualization. Use 'Sonner' for notifications. For the Kanban board, ensure drag-and-drop feels smooth (use a library like dnd-kit or react-beautiful-dnd if needed, or simple state management if simple). Mock all data with realistic B2B sales examples.
